review_locator: PMCID:PMC6281012, Recent advances in understanding inhibitor of apoptosis proteins, NOD signaling section; PMCID:PMC6783575, NOD Signaling and Cell Death, XIAP-RIPK2 section
primary_title: XIAP mediates NOD signaling via interaction with RIP2
decision_basis: The reviews identify XIAP BIR2 as a RIPK2-interacting scaffold; the cited primary demonstrates direct RIP2-XIAP association, BIR2 dependence, endogenous THP-1 association and XIAP-dependent NOD signaling.
limitations_preserved: Preserve RIPK2 kinase-domain/BIR2 interaction, cytosolic NOD1/NOD2 signalosome and ubiquitination context; no direct NOD-XIAP, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7484992, The Chemokine Receptor CXCR4 in Cell Proliferation and Tissue Regeneration, receptor internalization section
primary_title: beta-Arrestin1 and Distinct CXCR4 Structures Are Required for Stromal Derived Factor-1 to Downregulate CXCR4 Cell-Surface Levels in Neuroblastoma
decision_basis: The review describes beta-arrestin-dependent CXCR4 trafficking; the cited primary demonstrates beta-arrestin-1-dependent SDF-1/CXCR4 surface downregulation and tail-region requirements in neuroblastoma cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve neuroblastoma, CXCR4-tail, SDF-1/CXCL12 and cell-type/ligand dependence; beta-arrestin-2 can predominate elsewhere; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
